data.notes: Confirmed January 2027 music listings in Courchevel itself are sparse; the strongest nearby program is in Méribel/Mottaret, inside the same 3 Vallées ski area.

events.title: Jazz Variations Festival: ButtShakers
events.summary: The Buttshakers bring soul, funk, rhythm and blues, and rock energy to the Jazz Variations program in Méribel. The event is confirmed for January 14, 2027 from 21:00 to 22:30.

events.title: Jazz Variations Festival: Sian Pottok
events.summary: Sian Pottok brings a cross-cultural set shaped by jazz, folk, soul, alternative pop, Brazilian and African influences to Jazz Variations. The source confirms January 21, 2027 from 21:00 to 22:30.

events.title: Jazz Variations Festival: Salsa Libertad
events.summary: Jazz Variations presents Electrophazz, a septet blending electro-jazz with hip-hop and soul, at the Méribel auditorium. The source lists the performance from 21:00 to 22:30.

events.title: La Folie Douce Méribel-Courchevel daily après-ski show residency
events.summary: Daily high-altitude après-ski entertainment residency at the Saulire mid-station, with lunch-time immersive performance, bar/restaurant service, and La Folie Douce’s show-driven party format running through the winter season, including January 2027.

events.title: DJ Set and Festive Dinner
events.summary: A recurring Wednesday dinner-party format in Méribel Centre with a DJ set and open dance floor. January 13, 2027 is explicitly listed on the Méribel events calendar for the recurring event.

events.title: JRBB Concert
events.summary: JRBB reunites for a one-off blues-rock set at Le Rambler in Méribel Mottaret. The source confirms the show on January 14, 2027 from 22:00 to 01:00.

events.title: Le Bal des Rouges 2027
events.summary: A ticketed Courchevel Le Praz ball organized by Amicale de Ski Français La Tanière, with a formal-dress theme and late-night party format. The source confirms it runs from January 22 to 23, 2027, 19:30 to 01:00.

events.title: JessandWest Concert
events.summary: Twin-brother duo JessandWest perform rock, folk and blues-influenced live music at Le Rambler, mixing covers and originals. The source confirms the January 28, 2027 show from 22:00 to 01:00.

events.title: Hook Concert
events.summary: Hook, an eclectic rock-cover duo, plays Le Rambler in Méribel Mottaret. The source lists the January 12, 2027 show from 22:00 to 01:00.

events.title: Après-Ski Concert with Ben Vickers
events.summary: Ben Vickers performs a solo après-ski set using guitar, voice and loops, with repertoire across reggae, funk, soul and blues. The source confirms the January 18, 2027 performance from 17:30 to 20:00.

events.title: Après Live Music with Russell Stageman
events.summary: American musician Russell Stageman plays an après-ski rock set at Le Rambler in Méribel Mottaret. The source confirms a January 4, 2027 performance from 17:30 to 20:00.

events.title: Après Live Music with Flow
events.summary: Singer-guitarist Flow performs pop and rock classics using guitar, voice and live looping at Le Rambler. The source confirms the January 25, 2027 après-ski set from 17:30 to 20:00.

events.title: Live Music with Moon Serenade
events.summary: Moon Serenade plays a groove-led live set of pop, soul, funk, rock and blues covers at Le Rambler. The source confirms January 26, 2027 from 22:00 to 01:00.
